blockEvent.sql: CREATE TABLE "blockEvent" ("id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, "at" DATETIME NOT NULL, "ruleId" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES "blockRule"("id"), "sessionId" TEXT REFERENCES "session"("id"), "action" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK ("action" IN ('blocked', 'unblocked')), "reason" TEXT, "expiresAt" DATETIME)

blockRule.sql: CREATE TABLE "blockRule" ("id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK ("kind" IN ('domain', 'app')), "value" TEXT NOT NULL, "enabled" BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "createdAt" DATETIME NOT NULL, "updatedAt" DATETIME NOT NULL, "deletedAt" DATETIME)

blockRule_live.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX blockRule_live ON blockRule(kind, value COLLATE NOCASE) WHERE deletedAt IS NULL

breakDecision.sql: CREATE TABLE "breakDecision" ("sessionId" TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL REFERENCES "session"("id"), "decision" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK ("decision" IN ('taken', 'skipped')), "decidedAt" DATETIME NOT NULL)

browserClient.sql: CREATE TABLE "browserClient" ("id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, "extensionVersion" TEXT NOT NULL, "hostAccess" BOOLEAN NOT NULL, "connectedAt" DATETIME NOT NULL, "seenAt" DATETIME NOT NULL)

carryDecision.sql: CREATE TABLE "carryDecision" ("sourceTaskId" TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL REFERENCES "task"("id"), "decision" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK ("decision" IN ('accepted', 'dismissed')), "copyTaskId" TEXT UNIQUE REFERENCES "task"("id"), "destinationDay" TEXT, "decidedAt" DATETIME NOT NULL, CHECK ((decision = 'accepted' AND copyTaskId IS NOT NULL AND destinationDay IS NOT NULL) OR (decision = 'dismissed' AND copyTaskId IS NULL AND destinationDay IS NULL)))

category.sql: CREATE TABLE "category" ("id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "colorHex" TEXT NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "archived" BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "updatedAt" DATETIME NOT NULL, "deletedAt" DATETIME)

dayClose.sql: CREATE TABLE "dayClose" ("planId" TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL REFERENCES "dayPlan"("id"), "day" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "closedAt" DATETIME NOT NULL, "summaryJSON" TEXT NOT NULL)

dayPlan.sql: CREATE TABLE "dayPlan" ("id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, "day" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "createdAt" DATETIME NOT NULL, "committedAt" DATETIME, "updatedAt" DATETIME NOT NULL, "deletedAt" DATETIME)

focusWindow.sql: CREATE TABLE "focusWindow" ("id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, "weekday" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (("weekday" >= 1) AND ("weekday" <= 7)), "startMinute" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (("startMinute" >= 0) AND ("startMinute" < 1440)), "endMinute" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (("endMinute" >= 0) AND ("endMinute" <= 1440)), "createdAt" DATETIME NOT NULL, "updatedAt" DATETIME NOT NULL, "deletedAt" DATETIME, CHECK (startMinute <> endMinute))

focusWindow_live.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX focusWindow_live ON focusWindow(weekday, startMinute, endMinute) WHERE deletedAt IS NULL

grdb_migrations.sql: CREATE TABLE grdb_migrations (identifier TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY)

planCommitment.sql: CREATE TABLE "planCommitment" ("planId" TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL REFERENCES "dayPlan"("id"), "capturedAt" DATETIME NOT NULL, "tasksJSON" TEXT NOT NULL)

planningRun.sql: CREATE TABLE "planningRun" ("id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, "day" TEXT NOT NULL, "trigger" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "startedAt" DATETIME NOT NULL, "deadline" DATETIME NOT NULL, "finishedAt" DATETIME, "command" TEXT NOT NULL, "stdout" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "stderr" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "outputTruncated" BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "exitCode" INTEGER, "error" TEXT, "processGroup" INTEGER, "draftPlanId" TEXT REFERENCES "dayPlan"("id"), "notifiedAt" DATETIME, "supervisorPID" INTEGER)

planning_one_running.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX planning_one_running ON planningRun(status) WHERE status = 'running'

preference.sql: CREATE TABLE "preference" ("key" TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL)

recoveryGap.sql: CREATE TABLE "recoveryGap" ("id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, "startedAt" DATETIME NOT NULL, "endedAt" DATETIME, "lastObservedAt" DATETIME NOT NULL, "continuousSeconds" DOUBLE, "clockID" TEXT, "clockReliable" BOOLEAN NOT NULL, "sleeping" BOOLEAN NOT NULL, "locked" BOOLEAN NOT NULL, "awaySeconds" DOUBLE NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "state" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK ("state" IN ('observing', 'review', 'notRequired', 'kept', 'trimmed')), "decidedAt" DATETIME, CHECK ((state = 'observing' AND endedAt IS NULL) OR (state <> 'observing' AND endedAt IS NOT NULL)))

recovery_one_observing.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX recovery_one_observing ON recoveryGap(state) WHERE state = 'observing'

recoveryImpact.sql: CREATE TABLE "recoveryImpact" ("gapId" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES "recoveryGap"("id"), "sessionId" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES "session"("id"), "baselineWork" DOUBLE NOT NULL CHECK ("baselineWork" >= 0), "eligibleSeconds" DOUBLE NOT NULL CHECK ("eligibleSeconds" >= 0) DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("gapId", "sessionId"))

session.sql: CREATE TABLE "session" ("id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, "taskId" TEXT REFERENCES "task"("id"), "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "plannedSeconds" INTEGER NOT NULL, "startedAt" DATETIME NOT NULL, "pausedAt" DATETIME, "pausedSeconds" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "endedAt" DATETIME, "endReason" TEXT, "outcome" TEXT, "focusRating" INTEGER, "note" TEXT, "updatedAt" DATETIME NOT NULL, "reflectionPending" BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "recoveryTrimSeconds" DOUBLE NOT NULL CHECK ("recoveryTrimSeconds" >= 0) DEFAULT 0)

session_one_running.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX session_one_running ON session(endedAt IS NULL) WHERE endedAt IS NULL

step.sql: CREATE TABLE "step" ("id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, "taskId" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES "task"("id") ON DELETE CASCADE, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "done" BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "updatedAt" DATETIME NOT NULL)

tag.sql: CREATE TABLE "tag" ("id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE COLLATE NOCASE, "archived" BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "createdAt" DATETIME NOT NULL, "updatedAt" DATETIME NOT NULL)

task.sql: CREATE TABLE "task" ("id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, "dayPlanId" TEXT REFERENCES "dayPlan"("id"), "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "categoryId" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES "category"("id"), "blockMinutes" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("blockMinutes" > 0), "scheduledStart" DATETIME, "strict" BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "linearRef" TEXT, "notes" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "createdBy" TEXT NOT NULL, "updatedAt" DATETIME NOT NULL, "deletedAt" DATETIME, "doneAt" DATETIME, "carriedFromTaskId" TEXT REFERENCES "task"("id"))

task_carry_source.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX task_carry_source ON task(carriedFromTaskId) WHERE carriedFromTaskId IS NOT NULL

taskTag.sql: CREATE TABLE "taskTag" ("taskId" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES "task"("id") ON DELETE CASCADE, "tagId" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES "tag"("id") ON DELETE CASCADE, PRIMARY KEY ("taskId", "tagId"))
